title: Read-only node and checkout capabilities

effect.user: Fast-edit routing learns the installed Foundation and whether the selected local design exists.
assertions: One compact JSON line; discovered commands never executed; no files changed
Missing or unstamped runtime metadata remains unknown
A working-tree-only design can be present independently of Git HEAD

fixture.preset: owned checkout + readable working-tree design; isolated HOME with stamped or unstamped executable

recipe.readiness: Owned Cell with dependencies and fixed fixture; record runtime, host load and command population
recipe.completion: 20 fresh CLI processes return the expected facts with no writes
recipe.reset: Fresh isolated fixture HOME; no real installation changes
recipe.teardown: Trash only owned temporary fixture; retain JSON receipt

metrics.scope: spawn fresh CLI process to complete compact capabilities JSON and exit
metrics.collector: process.hrtime.bigint in parent; include startup and Git query; no profiler

budget.condition: Local read-only probe, warm filesystem and transpile cache; not a network/service or arbitrary filesystem latency guarantee

metrics.invariant: Every sampled command returns correct one-line facts and leaves fixture files unchanged.
metrics.noise: Shared Studio load varied19-40; receipts are observed recipe proof, not a stable baseline.

readiness: Earlier startup receipts are historical; lazy share dispatch changed main. Startup has not been remeasured for H2.
